## Setup

To run this project you need the original EU4 assets. Copy the following files from your EU4 installation folder into the `assets/` directory:

    ```
assets/
├── provinces.bmp
├── terrain.bmp
├── definition.csv
├── 00_countries.txt
├── provinces/
│   └── 1-UppLand.txt
└── countries/
    └── Sweden.txt
    ```
this will be replaced in the future with my own assets
